LSP4Metadata.name: Permission Control
LSP4Metadata.description: LSP8 collection for onchain LSP6 permission templates. Each minted token represents one immutable template version published by a Universal Profile (chain, permissions bitmap, allowed calls, allowed ERC725Y data keys, and metadata URI). Publishers pay a mint fee in LYX; the collection owner may update pricing and withdraw proceeds.
